descriptionEn: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap to a target location, damaging enemies in an area around where you land. Predator's Mark will be Triggered targeting the highest Rarity enemy Hit, or if a Mark gem is socketed into this Skill, that Mark will be Triggered instead. Using this Skill allows any Wolf Minions you have to leap immediately.
summaryPt: Vira lobisomem e salta até o local, causando dano na queda. Aplica a marca encaixada (Mark for Death) no inimigo mais raro atingido.
wherePt: Uncut Skill Gem (nível 3+). Precisa de talismã (forma de lobo).
